method: Rendered every final PDF page at 1.6x; viewed all six current contact sheets, detailed main pages 2/4/5/8 and supplemental page 14, plus the before/after first-page comparison. This reviews publication layout, not participant usability or dataset visual qualification.
checks: No clipped figure labels or overlapping table cells observed.
Thickness discrepancy uses a detail view; position and orientation use paired rear cameras.
Current/target and trajectory panels share group framing; annotations remain publication-only.
Filmstrip shows eight frames per row; final verdict labels are fully inside the figure.
Main narrow table columns use natural word spacing; no word is split across a page boundary.
Figures explain observation, one action, legal execution and updated state.
Worked F1/ER/SR example uses actual scorer values; unmeasured model results remain empty.
Main has eight body pages; references begin on page nine.
Supplement retains all nineteen result sheets and complete configuration inventories.
